name: PullQuote
summary: A line from an article repeated large between fading chrome lines, hidden from assistive technology.

guidance.useFor: Breaking up a long article with one line from it, set large.
insteadUse: Anything not already in the body: write it into the body
content: Repeat the body's words exactly, so nothing is lost by hiding it

rungReason: aria-hidden hides the repetition, since the body already says it; the rest is CSS.

keyboard.action: Passes over it: nothing here takes focus

rules: Never put a link or anything focusable in it: it is aria-hidden
Only words already in the body
forcedColors: The chrome lines become CanvasText borders
